description: Pick one AI-made browser game at random. Optional genre, AI tool, engine, multiplayer, and phone filters use the same matching rules as search_games. The result includes pageUrl, playUrl, credited AI tools, and engine.

ai_tool.description: AI tool credited by the creator. Partial names work: claude, claude-code, codex, cursor, grok, gemini, gpt.

engine.description: Engine or renderer, such as Three.js, Godot, PixiJS, Unity, or HTML5 Canvas.

genre.description: Genre slug or label, such as racing, puzzle, rpg, or "Action & Shooters".

mobile.description: True for games that work on a phone.

multiplayer.description: True for multiplayer only. False for single-player only.

name: random_game
title: Pick a random AI browser game
